footerLandmark.iap:description: Names the group of footer links for somebody navigating by landmark rather than by sight; never displayed. It tells them what they have arrived at, so translate it as the name of the part of the page, the way a screen reader would announce it.

footerBuiltBy.iap:description: Precedes the DATA team's logo, which follows it as an image and is not translated. An unfinished phrase on purpose — the logo completes the sentence, so a language that puts the maker before the verb needs to be able to reorder that, and a translation ending in a colon or a full stop would read as a heading instead.
